acceptanceCriteria: Local reference source is required explicitly and its Git HEAD is checked against a recorded 40-character commit.
No active conformance script or GitHub Actions job fetches the public reference URL or requires network access to the reference repository.
Historical inventory and Work Item evidence remain immutable; current documentation distinguishes historical baseline from the local current source.
Offline semantic conformance remains executable in hosted CI without copying V1 Runtime code or Python modules.
Three-language reference documentation and conformance instructions describe the local-source workflow and fail-closed missing/mismatched source behavior.
goal: Bind future reference comparisons to an explicit local Git checkout and pinned commit, remove active public-network reference dependency from conformance CI, and document the semantic/non-copy boundary.
intent: Use the operator-maintained local reference checkout as the sole current comparison source after the public reference repository is closed, while preserving historical comparison truth.
outOfScope: copying the reference Python/Make/runtime or source fixtures
